periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique-vertical orientation, angled approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovaloid profile, where the vertical axis is significantly greater than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced ventral tapering extending the patch boundary well below the ocular center point.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape profile across the dorsal midline with a relatively flat posterior edge.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band occupying approximately 20-25% of the visible dorsal-ventral trunk length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation by white cranial fur, spanning a distance roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the top margins of both pinnae.
